name: Hide Invis Msgs
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: Bluebird
description: Obfuscates / hides death messages and kill messages that invisible players get. Both default to true but can be edited through gamerule commands.
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
